reviews.name: Mark G
reviews.text: Dale and his team did a brilliant job for us. They really listened to what we wanted and worked with us without simply imposing their own ideas. The end result is something that brings us so much enjoyment and complements our house perfectly. No hesitation in recommending Dale.

reviews.name: Gary Teagle
reviews.text: 15 years ago, Dale landscaped our property & has continued to maintained the gardens ever since. He & his team have not only been very professional & courteous, but they are always happy to advise & give ideas when needed. I would recommend Dale to anyone wanting to create a special garden.

reviews.name: Elaine Connor
reviews.text: Dale does amazing stonework and creates wonderful gardens with interesting features and shapes. His recommendation of a particular sculpture for our garden was a brilliant solution to a design flaw of the house and has given us great pleasure. Highly recommend him.

reviews.name: Sam Brewer
reviews.text: Dale and his team have done two large scale landscaping jobs for us in Kangaroo Valley. Dale is very approachable and has an amazing eye for design, but is also flexible in terms of budget and ideas. I would not hesitate to recommend DP

reviews.name: Bernadette Wyer
reviews.text: Dale has worked with us for 10 years. He has done several landscaping jobs over that time. Dale is easy to work with and open to ideas. We continue to use the services of Dale, his team are very respectful and polite. We would recommend Dale's services.

reviews.name: Tim Mason
reviews.text: Dale and his team did a great job. They were on time honest and very hard working in sometimes difficult conditions. A definite shout out for Trent Matt and James who got the job done. Highly recommended for a job of any size

faq.a: We're based in Falls Creek and work across the Shoalhaven — Nowra, Berry, Kiama, Kangaroo Valley and Jamberoo. If you're nearby but not on that list, call and ask.

faq.q: Do you design gardens as well as build them?
faq.a: Yes. Consultation and garden design come first, so what gets built matches what you asked for — and we work with your architect or builder if you have one.

faq.q: Will you look after the garden once it's finished?
faq.a: Yes — garden maintenance is one of our core services, and several clients have kept us on for years after the original job. One client has been with us for ten years, another for fifteen.

faq.q: What size jobs do you take on?
faq.a: Both large and small. Reviewers mention two separate large-scale jobs in Kangaroo Valley, and others describe smaller design and maintenance work — "highly recommended for a job of any size."

faq.q: How do I get a quote?
faq.a: Call or text Dale on 0402 469 118, or send the details through the form below.

_source.aboutText:
Started in 1996 by Dale Pickering, the business employs ten members, passionate about creating and maintaining beautiful gardens and outdoor living spaces.

Working closely with both Sydney based and local architects, large construction firms and rural and residential property owners across the Shoalhaven and surrounding areas, Dale’s experience in the field of landscape gardening spans the last 20 years.

Our qualified team is dedicated to producing unique landscape settings, through careful planning, professional construction, and follow up maintenance. A complete landscape service ensures each individually designed project, built to the highest standard, flourishes to its full potential.
